## About
Alli Pest Control is a local pest control company based in The Woodlands, TX. When customers write about us, they usually mention Joey by name.
Reviewers describe the work as thorough and the communication as clear. One customer wrote that Joey made sure the job was done right without any high-pressure sales tactics, and another said he didn't just stay a few minutes and leave.
We're rated 5 on Google from 50 reviews. If bugs are showing up in your house, yard or office, give us a call.

## Services
- House and yard treatment: Treatment for your home and yard. One customer said they noticed a big drop in insect sightings afterward.
- Office pest control: Pest control for businesses as well as homes. One reviewer brought Joey in for a bug problem at a new office.
- Treatment plan: One customer said Joey treated everything at their office and got them set up on a plan.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What's your phone number?
A: You can call us at (281) 297-8855 during business hours.
